summary: A website for a shoes shop.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Wide lifestyle hero banner showing stylish sneakers and shoes arranged on a clean surface with warm neutral tones (hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png)
- Brand logo mark — a minimalist shoe silhouette icon in charcoal on a transparent background (logo-icon.dim_128x128.png)
- Sample men's athletic sneaker product photo on white background (product-mens-sneaker.dim_600x600.png)
- Sample women's heeled boot product photo on white background (product-womens-boot.dim_600x600.png)
- Sample kids' colorful sneaker product photo on white background (product-kids-sneaker.dim_600x600.png)
- Sample unisex casual loafer product photo on white background (product-casual-loafer.dim_600x600.png)

existing_features.title: Create a homepage with a full-width hero section featuring a compelling tagline and call-to-action button, followed by a featured products grid showcasing selected shoes.
Create a product listing page that displays all shoes organized by category (e.g., Men, Women, Kids, Sport) with filter options for size, color, and price range.
Create a product detail page showing multiple product images, product name, description, available sizes, color options, price, and an Add to Cart button.
Implement a shopping cart that allows users to add products, adjust quantities, remove items, and see a running total.
Create an About/Contact page with a brief brand story, contact form (name, email, message), and store information (address, phone, hours).

Apply a bold, modern visual theme across the entire site using a warm neutral palette (off-white, charcoal, warm tan/caramel accents), strong sans-serif typography, generous whitespace, and clean card layouts that evoke a premium retail aesthetic.

new_feature_requests.summary: Homepage with hero section and featured products
Product listing page with categories and filters
Product detail page with images, description, and add-to-cart
Implement a backend data store in Motoko for shoe products, including fields: id, name, description, category, price, available sizes, colors, and image URLs.
